description: Source code for NetworkManagerLogger, a logging utility with support for RDK logger integration, including functions for log level mapping, path trimming, initialization, and formatted logging.

methods.name: mapTordkLogLevel
methods.description: Maps internal LogLevel to RDK_LOG level if RDK logger is used.

methods.name: trimPath
methods.description: Extracts filename from a full file path.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Initializes the logger, optionally using configuration files.

methods.name: logPrint
methods.description: Formats and outputs log messages, either via RDK logger or stdout.

methods.name: GetLevel
methods.description: Retrieves the current default log level.
